decision: Detect routing, canonical-authority, scope, projection, validation, and self-certification failures before release; this suite does not approve authored instruction systems.

scope.intended_use: Creating and revising scoped repository instruction systems through their canonical owners.
scope.case_source: Synthetic instruction systems covering broad and local scope, managed projections, accepted findings, behavioral-value claims, and neighboring responsibilities.

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names and descriptions until a single selection or required ordered composition is recorded.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the target explicitly in a disposable task-local workspace with only declared synthetic inputs.

evidence.storage: Keep source under evals and write routine runs only to the ignored or external evaluation workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing and file-state checks plus assertion-based review of scope, authority, reconciliation, and handoff behavior.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable harness state, projection ownership, output, or side-effect evidence produce unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: Only canonical sources and owned projections change
The authored workflow does not expand authority
Authoring does not claim audit closure
Structural validation is not reported as behavioral improvement
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: Previous accepted exact revision under the same cases, environment, budgets, and graders when available.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline rather than inferring improvement.

critical_assertions.gate: Only canonical sources and owned projections change
critical_assertions.assertion: The response edits AGENTS.md as the declared canonical source rather than CLAUDE.md.

critical_assertions.gate: The authored workflow does not expand authority
critical_assertions.assertion: Only the smallest responsible instruction surfaces change.

critical_assertions.gate: Authoring does not claim audit closure
critical_assertions.assertion: The author reports finding dispositions and entry-point evidence without declaring independent audit closure.

critical_assertions.gate: Structural validation is not reported as behavioral improvement
critical_assertions.assertion: Loading, route resolution, or adherence is reported as structural evidence rather than proof of improved task performance.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed scope.

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.

provenance.independence: Same-agent evidence must remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Host, model, catalog, authority, or intended-cohort changes
